Competitive Amla Powder Price Per Kg Options

Amla powder, also called Indian gooseberry powder, is made from dried amla fruit milled into a fine, sour-tasting powder. Tradenest Naturals supplies it to food manufacturers, nutraceutical brands and private label packers around the world. If you are comparing amla powder price per kg offers, we give clear quotes for both trial lots and regular bulk orders. Our raw amla powder wholesale supply is made from fruit carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers in India. Because we handle processing and packing ourselves, we can keep costs fair for bulk buyers. We dehydrate whole Indian gooseberries and mill them into a fine, free-flowing powder that blends well in dry mixes and capsules. Whether you need bulk amla powder supplier india services or private label packing, we shape our service around your commercial requirements. Tell us how you plan to use the powder, and we will recommend the right pack format.

Careful Processing and Quality Control

Good amla powder starts with good fruit. We source mature Indian gooseberries through trusted grower networks. Sorting removes damaged or unripe fruit before it enters production. After washing and destoning, the fruit is dehydrated under controlled conditions to help keep its natural colour, sour taste and characteristic aroma. Our milling equipment then grinds the dried fruit so that it passes through 100 mesh. Throughout the process, our team checks moisture, colour and particle size. As a result, each batch is consistent and easy to work with. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This open approach is one reason buyers return to us among indian gooseberry manufacturers.

Key Technical Specifications & Fine Granulation

Particle size matters in food processing and supplement manufacturing. Our amla powder 100 mesh grade blends into dry mixes, capsules and drink powders with little clumping. Below are the standard technical parameters for our export-grade product:
  • Botanical Name: Emblica officinalis
  • Mesh Size: Fully passing through 100 mesh
  • Moisture Content: < 7.0%
  • Processing: Dehydrated
  • Color: Natural light greenish-brown to greyish-green
  • Taste & Aroma: Characteristic sour, astringent and herbal profile

Applications in Food, Beverage, and Herbal Products

Amla is one of the most widely used fruits in Indian herbal traditions. Our dehydrated amla powder is used across several industries. Formulators add it to drink mixes, herbal teas and dietary supplement blends. Cosmetic brands include it in herbal hair masks, face packs and natural skincare products. Supplement companies often choose our amla powder wholesale shipments for capsules, tablets and powder blends. Food processors use it in tangy beverage premixes, snacks, chutneys and traditional Ayurvedic formulations. Its sour, astringent flavour adds authentic character wherever a natural tart note is wanted. Because the powder is dehydrated whole fruit with nothing added, it also suits brands that want a short, simple ingredient list.

Buyer Value and Export Support

When you buy bulk amla powder from Tradenest Naturals, you work with an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter. We know that importers need dependable supply and transparent documentation. That is why we provide export documentation support with every consignment. Our export packaging protects the powder from moisture, light and humidity during long-distance transit. Stored cool and dry, the shelf life is 24 months. We invite you to evaluate the product yourself. Samples are available on request, so you can test the powder in your own production or R&D setting. Our minimum order is 5 Kg. Contact our export sales team to discuss volumes, packaging and current pricing.
